$comment: Open-source lab registry — the owner's 30-repo research index, transcribed into a governed artifact. Machine half; the human half is docs/OPEN_SOURCE_LAB_REGISTRY.md and the gate is scripts/check-lab-registry.mjs. deployedInLab is TRUE only for services scripts/run-live-lanes.sh actually starts today; classification records intent, not deployment.

rule.boundary: external system → source adapter → normalized evidence → freshness + provenance + contradictions → deterministic policy → verdict
rule.neverRule: No repository's code is copied or embedded into SignalGrid until its licence has been reviewed against the distribution model. Studying, deploying as a separate lab service, and speaking a wire protocol are not the same act as embedding code.

entries.basis: recorded from owner research 2026-08-21, verify before any code reuse
